title: Machine Learning Engineer
description:
Location: Pune
Experience: 38 years
Role Overview:
We are seeking a highly skilled AI/ML Developer to design, develop, and deploy machine learning models and AI-driven solutions. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in modern ML frameworks, cloud platforms, and emerging technologies such as generative AI, LLMs, and MLOps.
Key Responsibilities:
Design and implement machine learning models for predictive analytics, NLP, computer vision, and recommendation systems.
Develop and fine-tune Large Language Models (LLMs) and Generative AI applications.
Build scalable ML pipelines using MLOps best practices (CI/CD for ML).
Optimize models for performance, accuracy, and cost efficiency.
Collaborate with data engineers and product teams to integrate ML solutions into production systems.
Stay updated with the latest AI/ML trends and research to drive innovation.
Required Skills & Qualifications:
Strong programming skills in Python (and optionally R, Java, or C++).
Expertise in ML frameworks: TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-learn, Hugging Face Transformers.
Experience with Generative AI, LLMs, and Prompt Engineering.
Knowledge of Deep Learning, NLP, Computer Vision, and Reinforcement Learning.
Familiarity with MLOps tools: MLflow, Kubeflow, Airflow, Docker, Kubernetes.
Cloud experience: AWS SageMaker, Azure ML, or Google Vertex AI.
Strong understanding of data preprocessing, feature engineering, and model evaluation.
Proficiency in API development and microservices architecture for ML deployment.
Nice-to-Have Skills:
Experience with Vector Databases (e.g., Pinecone, Weaviate) for AI search.
Knowledge of Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) and Federated Learning.
Familiarity with Responsible AI, Bias Mitigation, and Explainable AI (XAI).
Exposure to Edge AI and IoT-based ML solutions.

title: Machine Learning Engineer
description:
Our Company

Changing the world through digital experiences is what Adobe's all about. We give everyone-from emerging artists to global brands-everything they need to design and deliver exceptional digital experiences! We're passionate about empowering people to create beautiful and powerful images, videos, and apps, and transform how companies interact with customers across every screen.

We're on a mission to hire the very best and are committed to creating exceptional employee experiences where everyone is respected and has access to equal opportunity. We realize that new ideas can come from everywhere in the organization, and we know the next big idea could be yours!
Adobe is seeking a Machine Learning Engineer to join the Genuine Engineering team-a group dedicated to protecting Adobe's ecosystem from fraud, abuse, and misuse through intelligent, ML-driven systems.
You'll work on designing, building, and scaling machine learning models that detect fraudulent behavior, prevent account sharing, and ensure a safe and seamless experience for millions of Adobe users worldwide.
In this role, you'll collaborate closely with data scientists, product engineers, and infrastructure teams to take ML models from experimentation to full-scale deployment. You'll combine deep technical expertise in ML, data engineering, and distributed systems with a passion for solving complex, high-impact problems.
Key Responsibilities
Lead the design, development, and deployment of production-grade ML models for fraud detection, anomaly detection, and behavioral analytics.
Translate research and prototypes into scalable, reliable ML systems running across Adobe's platforms.
Collaborate cross-functionally with product, data, and infrastructure teams to define technical requirements and deliver high-impact solutions.
Build and optimize data pipelines for feature engineering, model training, and real-time inference using modern tools (Databricks, Spark, etc.).
Ensure model scalability, reliability, and performance through continuous monitoring, evaluation, and iteration.
Contribute to MLOps practices including CI/CD, model versioning, and automated retraining workflows.
Stay ahead of advancements in ML/AI, bringing new techniques and innovations to Adobe's products.
Minimum Qualifications
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Data Science, or related field.
6+ years of professional experience building and deploying ML solutions at scale.
Strong programming expertise in Python, with hands-on experience in PyTorch, TensorFlow, or similar frameworks.
Proven experience with distributed data systems (Spark, Databricks, or Hadoop ecosystem).
Deep understanding of the end-to-end ML lifecycle-from data collection to deployment and monitoring.
Strong grasp of model optimization, inference efficiency, and production system integration.
Experience working in cloud environments (AWS, Azure, or GCP) with containerized workflows (Docker, Kubernetes).
Excellent problem-solving skills and ability to work in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience in fraud detection, anomaly detection, or behavioral modeling.
Familiarity with responsible AI frameworks focusing on fairness, interpretability, and transparency.
Contributions to open-source ML frameworks or publications in applied ML.
